nom: Peter Thomas Roth 24K Gold Pure Luxury Lift & Firm Hydra-Gel Eye Patches

avis.texte: As a professional Makeup Artist, I use these on the people who sit in my chair and I can say it is a luxury experience for them. They all ask me what I used. They want to purchase it and they love the way it looks. It really helps tighten and brighten the under eye before apply makeup. For everybody saying that they use them for a month and don't see a difference, etc. this is not plastic surgery. You're going to have to use them every day for when you put on your make up or you want to go out and you want to look refreshed, it is not going to change your eyes forever. Don't go into it with those expectations.
Only just started to use these, not sure yet how good they are. A little difficult to separate each one.

I use these every morning when I get up. I am obsessed. They take away all my morning eye puffiness, they leave my eyes feeling cool and hydrated all day. I feel they are lessening my dark circles a bit and making my eyes look bigger and brighter. I have received so many compliments since I started using these saying I look younger, healthier, happier and like I got more sleep. My under eyes have always been a major struggle for me which is sad because im only 28 but these have been a game changer and are helping take away one of my biggest insecurities.

Aside from these having a bad smell, they were so slippery they might as well be cheek or chin patches. They sure don't stay under your eyes. Don't think that laying down will trick them into staying in place. NO! Now you have slimy ear patches! Ulta should just retire this line frankly. It seems like everything in this brand is less effective that so may alternatives at much more reasonable prices.

I am the worlds biggest skeptic, but I hesitatingly purchased these online ( ok, it was a sale…) I am Completely AMAZED with the results using these eye patches! Puffiness: gone. Under eye texture and moisture vastly improved. Under eye darkness- improved (albeit not gone), but that is what concealer is for. Love it!
I always keep these on hand. They work beautifully. A luxury sure, but a luxury that does exactly what it's supposed to do.

Over half of the eye patches in my jar were ripped so I could not use them. What a waste! There was also not enough serum in the jar to make them effective. I prefer other brands that leaves me feeling more hydrated.
These are absolutely splendid. Love the way the gel feels sf against my skin. Be consistent with these for the best results.

I was so excited to try these! After biting the bullet and paying full price for them i would not recommend. They are too dry and not effective at all in my opinion. They need to put more serum in the jar or find a way to keep them moistened because there is no point in wearing them as dry as they are.

It's ridiculous that we pay so much for beauty products and they keep reducing quality. PTR used to have the best eye patches. They've reduced the serum so much that's non-existent. Don't waste your money.
I was so excited to try these only to be disappointed by the lack of serum. I've used Non luxury brands with better results.

This product came free when I bought the cloud moisturizer. I had no expectations, but the first time I tried them I was happily surprised. It made the skin under my eyes look well nourished young and taught. Peter Thomas Roth is my go to for great skin care. I've enjoyed so many cool samples and they keep making new things. I'll never go astray.
Picked these up during the sale, dont think they are worth full price. Helps with puffiness but not so much with dark circles and lines. I had better results with less expensive patches.

This is amazing! I have allergies, bags, wrinkles, and brown under my eyes! I've tried popular leadings brands that did nothing!! I used the hydra gel patches and they made a huge difference!! I love this product. 💯 worth the money!
It is overpriced. Patches are dry, there's hardly any gel/serum on them. Not worth the money.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again.
avis.texte: I love how they feel cool once you apply them. I love to use these in the morning after washing my face, while doing my hair. They feel nice and also make my under eyes brighter and less sunk-in looking! My under eyes feel softer as well.
These work okay, they aren't great for the price point though. Also the shape of the eye gel itself is weird.

avis.titre: The worst product I've ever purchased
avis.texte: This is quite literally the worst product I've ever purchased from Ulta. These eye patches get some negerive reciews but they were on sale for the 21 Day of Beauty event so I thought I'd take a chance on them and try it out. As it turns out, the negative reciews were more than warrented. They are cut with such a drastic curve that they dont fit around your eyes. They are so slippery that they don't stay on. They burn the skin sround your eyes. They dry out and crack fast. They are just an uter nightmare and waste of money! This is easily the worst beauty product on the market! I hated this so much that I will never buy another PTR product again and I'm going to research the parent company to ensure I dont spend my money on affiliated brands. Absolute trash!

Often times i use eye patches and dont see results but these leave my undereyes nice and luminous with a nice golden sheen. Depuffs and i look refreshed! Love these and will purchase again when i run out.

Got these during the beauty steal event and bought it in a pack with their cloud cream. They stay on have grip. My undereyes feel/look tighter and smoother. I'm going to keep buying these at full price if I need to and stock up when they're on sale! (The cloud cream is amazing too!)
Had high hopes for these patches. They were horrible. Barely any serum and they dried out very quickly. So dry they would not stay put. Save your money.
Unfortunately had a huge allergic reaction. Had to treat with medication for over a month

I bought this after doing a lot of research on possible products to help with under eye skin. I used them as directed twice and was left with red, puffy, sagging burn marks under both eyes! So disappointed ☹️

I bought these after a friend said they were amazing. And she was sooooo right!!! I naturally have bags but when I'm tired or upset they get very pronounced. I could feel and see my eyes looking more alive after one use.
Best products I've ever used feels so clean on my face and the gold eye patches r amazing

Definitely disappointed with this one. I was excited to invest into a good eye treatment assuming the expensive price meant results. No. Zero difference. Been using frequently for months now. Still. Zero results. Not worth your money.
Patch is dry and irritatedy skin. Got them on sale. I'm glad I didnt pay full price.

Like other reviews have stated, there's no eye serum on the eye patches. They're basically dry. I left the container upside down for days and shook it only to find that there's nothing on these eye patches. Save your money and buy something else.

Mine were so dry. I would grab the ones from the bottom so they felt like they had a little bit of product on them. Only thing these did was felt cool (i kept refrigerated) under my eyes. No difference in brightness, softening lines or reducing puffiness.

It works!!! I love it! Hydrates my skin in the morning. Makes me look refreshed. I put them on while I'm taking care of the household. (I'm a multitask type of gal). Getting kids ready, walking dogs, work, etc. People say they are dry. They're not as " liquidy" as others that I've tried. However, they work so well and they fit with my lifestyle. I would recommend them for anyone who doesn't have time to lay down for 15 minutes and make sure their eyepatch doesn't slide down their face.
I don't understand why they are so expensive. No serum. I'm returning.
Love this product - made my 59 year old under eye wrinkles go away for a few hours (lasts about 5 hours). Will definitely buy again.

I snagged these on a deal, but I'm so glad because these really work! I've been having a hard time with puffiness and dark circles. Since using these for only a week or so, I already see a huge change!!
Very dissatisfied and disappointed with the product. The patches are extremely dry, no serum on them. There is no serum in the container at all. What did I pay for?
No serum detected in jar or on patches. Patches are cooling but that is all.
These eye patches are dry. No serum! I thought it was a fluke and was silly enough to buy them again and the same thing, dry. Don't waste your money.

Ive tried just about every eye patch on the market. These eye patches are just ok, and the price is too high for the results. I keep them in the refrigerator too. I've found 2 other eye patches at a lower price point that work much better for my puffy morning eyes.

If you have an aversion to the scent of pickled-ginger included alongside your favorite Sushi or Sashimi entrée, in that case…buyer beware. Scent aside, De-Puffing is exceptional when chilled in fridge. Gold is camouflaged easily under big shades 😎

Im almost mad that i love these so much because of how pricey they are. Ive been struggling with my fine lines and dark undereyes and when i tell YOU.. when i took these off it looked like i had concealer on. It immediately brightened my under eyes and blurred my smooth lines. Idk what magic is in this but i need it for my whole face. I even grabbed my roomate and they thought i put concealer under my eye. Unfortunately im buying another one immediately. I never write reviews but i just had to because i was that impressed.
I bought these hoping they would help my cirlces under my eyes. They did not help and i also did not get what i paid for becuase there was no serum in the eye gel container! Very disappointed.
I absolutely love the effects of these eye patches. They are so cool and soothing while I relax. The results are immediate.

I was really excited to try these eye patches because I love the face mask. I opened it up and the patches were completely dry. Like bone dry. I think it's funny the directions say to pat the extra serum onto your skin after removing when there was none to begin with. I'm extremely disappointed because I've never had an issue with this brand. Will be taking these back as I have absolutely no use for them.

Absolutely do not waste your money bestie. I ordered these in late October of 2022 and it is February 3rd 2023 and my entire container has dried out. (yes, I've kept it in a dry place and I kept the lid clasped shut.) These are now dry eye patches, yuck! Definitely not worth the money! I've gotten better eye patches for less $ and eye creams that are more affective than this honey do not waste your hard earned cash on these
The shape of these is horrible. Your paying for a brand. That is all. Do yourself a favor and go get skynn Iceland eye patches.

I hoped they would work. I saved up points for these and wished I used them for something else. I've used the Skynn and Florence by Mills and had better results. I know everyone's skin is different, but not for me.

I have been going through some bad anxiety insomnia, so these have helped me reduce puffiness under the eyes and feel refreshed! I cleanse my skin, then slap these on for 15 min and bam! Looking fresher already!

I'd wanted these eye patches for a while but hesitated due to the cost. I finally purchased them and I'm genuinely so disappointed:( they arrived completely dried out and do absolutely nothing for eye issues. Absolute waste of money

This is kind of a wild way to start a review, but stick with me: my mother and sister and I bought these after my dad died. Nothing makes your eyes ridiculously puffy and red like days of sleeplessness and crying, right? We thought we deserved a little treat, and I'll tell you, these things WORK. We put them in the fridge for a little extra de-puffing power, and they really helped relieve some of that swollen, exhausted feeling beneath the eyes -- and they felt luxurious to boot. I'm typically skeptical about these kinds of products, but in this case, there really was a visible difference. A depressing use case, but look, if that's not a good review, then what is? I'm giving them a 4/5 primarily because the price is kind of steep; I wouldn't say they're a regular occasion type of product for me, but I'd be willing to try one of the cheaper options from this line for that purpose.

avis.titre: Wish I would have found these sooner!
avis.texte: I have tried a LOT of different under eye patches for my dehydrated skin and deep crows feet . These are the first ones that I actually saw a visible difference after 1 or 2 uses. I use them almost ever night with amazzzzzzing results.

avis.titre: Purchased  to reduce swelling  from reaction
avis.texte: One of the sales associates offered me a set of these to calm my eyes down from a reaction from another cream and my goodness it was so soothing. I purchased some shared with my mom and I find myself putting them on morning and night. They are so soothing and pampering. I wish I would have known about these previously . They are so worth the price. I will agree with another reviewer there should be more product liquid or serum but it's absolutely wonderful. They do come in numerous categories. Cucumber, hydraulic and one or two others but this one is my favorite. I have tried the other's. This one is supreme.....❤

I have a bagg under my left eye that is not that bad and it seems like the bagg moved up some like it is trying to go away or either it's from the water I recently started drinking everyday compared to barely drinking any. So I will try them one last time. i sent a email to let them know and as of a week later no one has responded as much as they cost you would think they would contact me back thus far. I did use them everyday in the morning hem every day in the morning and I am not satisfied.
These eye patches are AMAZING! I suffer from really bad/dark under eye bags.. and these have helped me immensely. 10/10 recommend

avis.titre: I will buy again and again!
avis.texte: Results last up to 3 days, I've noticed. I just turned 35 and needed a pick me up. I have 3 kiddos my youngest being 4 months and I was feeling and looking worn out. These definitely give the illusion of a good nights rest! Haha! Love these and will buy every time Ulta has a sale. Cheap when compared to other under-eye patches because you have 30 sets in this container! This should last 3-4 months. Very very happy with these!
Well that actually work and you look amazing after however there are shaped/cut funny. The make the inner piece pointed. So weird and they don't really stay up because of that. So decide for yourself
They actually work! Tightens, moisturizing & brighTens.. instantly! Will certainly repurchase

avis.auteur: Bottomline- I say splurge on these !
avis.texte: I work 50 hours a week, and sometimes lack on getting enough sleep... I usually sleep with these on and after using about 2-3x a week there's been a good difference on my dark circles and texture near my eyes! While I did ball out and use my points for this it lost a star because it's just a tad out of my budget :/
Love this product. I use it everyday before applying my makeup.

I'm normally not crazy puffy, but sleepless nights since starting teaching in this crazy school year have wreaked havoc on my eyes. These feel soothing and great, but the shape is awkward and they do nothing to relieve the puffiness. TBH, black tea bags have been doing the trick and are WAY cheaper...
I so recommend these. I noticed a difference right away! Feels so good on the eyes, I recommend
I have tried everything and this is the only product that actually helps with under eye puffiness. Only down side is the price point. If they made this into a serum it'd be more cost effective.

Feels cooling & soothing - wonderful, actually. Upon removal there was a noticeable difference in dark circles and puffiness. Within a few hours, the results are gone. I'm going to try these prior to a makeup application and see if that makes a difference to my skin.
These are amazing. they reduce puffiness- dark circles- wrinkles-i am in love!
These are wonderful! I use them on top of any PTR mask, then rub the serm in when I remove them. Well worth the price for me.

I love these eye patches, they do not slide down and stay put as I walk around in the morning when I first get up to get coffee and such. I wake up with puffy eyes a lot, so I decided to give these a try. Holy Grail of eye patches!!! I left them on for a total of 10 mins the first time, and when I took them off, my eyes had no more puffiness....They looked like I had a full nights rest! I received them free in a gift from something else I bought from PTR....I want to buy again, but they are pricey!

These little gel patches are miracle workers. I'm about to turn 45 and have a laundry list of health issues that is taking its toll on my face and skin. I haven't had problems with these patches sliding at all. You just smooth the patches out along your eye area using your finger to make sure there are no air bubbles. I sent before and after photos of my eyes to my friends, and they ran out to get some. My typical skincare routine includes Neutrogena and no7 serum, so this has to be special for me to spend the money on it. Worth every penny.

I will say that you need to be able to take the time to LAY DOWN and use these for a good 20 minutes. I cannot get up and do things or they consistently slide down my face. I have not noted anything overall magical yet, but have only used about 3 times so I will trial the whole jar first to see. so far I would not repurchase for the price.

I didn't want to like these and am not sure I'll repurchase, TBH. The main problem I have with all PTR eye gels is that they contain Carrageenan. I have Ulcertative Colitis, and my doctor has told me to avoid all products with carrageenan, as it is a known irritant to the colon. I know that carrageenan is a large molecule that sits on the skin, doesn't get into the blood stream, and therefore is "safer" to use topically. However, I just always try to avoid carrageenan in skincare. Yes, I should have read the label more carefully before splurging on this product, and that is my fault. However, this product is highly effective at giving you a better looking under eye area. It does reduce any puffiness, any discoloration and temporarily plumps the under eye area. You can also use them for smile lines around the mouth. However, I haven't tried that yet. I'd probably buy any of PTR's eye gels...if he just removed the carrageenan. Love you PTR! Please remove the carrageenan.

I've tried several kinds of underwear the eye care products... definitely one of my very favorites. Works really well. One of my besties got me on this and I have now passed this gem to my other friends.

avis.titre: I would buy this again and again
avis.texte: This works. I will wake up with puffy eyes. I apply the patches, wait 10 min and the puffiness is gone. This product works !!

These are expensive but worth it! I have puffiness due to allergies and these gel pads worked well. Bags weren't totally gone but a significant change was seen. Il keep buying them! And they are soothing and made me feel refreshed.

avis.titre: These do more lightening than de-puff for me.
avis.texte: I bought these to help combat dark circles and puffiness. They do a lot for dark circles; after 10/15 mins my under-eye area is definitely brighter. However, they do very little for puffiness for me. However, they're the best eye patch I've found, for the price, so I keep buying them!

avis.titre: My skin at 42 has never been better
avis.texte: Ok so I just bought this based on fabulous reviews and past wonderful experiences using PTR products and I assure you I'm not disappointed! After one use I'm a secured frequent buyer. The cooling, calming effect is wonderful. I don't particularly enjoy wearing the patches but I'll do it for these results. I have a pesky smile line at top of my cheek right under my eye that has been getting more pronounced as of late and after removing the patch it had completely disappeared!!!! Sold!! It's pricey and sux gettin hooked to expensive but too late hehe.
These are miracle workers! Super easy to apply and goodbye baggy, swollen eyes! I use them 2-3 times a week and will definitely rebuy! Happy customer!
Hydration is essential for the under eye area. I use these everyday

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: I generally do not write reviews as I find most products do not deliver what they promise, but this product definitely has delivered. Very soothing to the eye area (I have seasonal allergies and this is a bad time of year for my eyes) and i have noticed a plumpness to my under and corner eye areas, which makes the crows feet much less noticeable.

I have used a couple other eye patches from cheaper brands and they usually work a little. No miracles but some improvement. Was excited to find these. If you do the math, the patches are actually a good deal since there are 30 pairs. But they did not work for me. At all! I feel like they actually made my under eyes look worse than before. I will be returning and sticking to the cheaper brands
I was using Clinique but it added up quick this give you double the amount for the money

I tried these after so many good reviews to see if they were as good as everyone said, they are! I have a terrible time sleeping and when I get up I look like it. I tries these two different occasions and I couldn't believe how much better my puffiness looked. I will continue to buy these as long as they make them!

These eye patches are very pricey. As of now (about a 2 weeks in)I am loving them. I can tell the difference when I don't use them. They do give some life back under your eye. I have dark circles and a sunken in under eye. Thanks to genetics - and honestly do not know of anything that will truly fix or get rid of this but this nice to help me look a little better. Again I can tell when I don't put them on. Once they are on they will eventually dry in place but at first they're a little slippery.
Use this first thing in the morning on work days...... Treat yourself and get this product! Notice less puffiness and smoother around my eyes the first day using.

avis.titre: Wow! All I can say is WOW!
avis.texte: I have bought so many beauty and anti aging products that I could probably open up my own store lol. I've spent thousands of dollars on products for my double bags under my eyes and the dark circles. Never ever have I bought a product that worked INSTANTLY!! I am now a faithful buyer/believer of PTR products! I love these patches, how they feel and love the results even better. I'm thoroughly impressed!

I've had mild crow's feet for a few years. I used these patches once overnight and my crows feet are competely gone. On top of that my bottom eyelid twitches a few times a day and after using these it relaxed my eye muscles and the twitching as completely stopped.

I'm beginning to think that any all eye creams, masks and serums are just scams. Bought these, because of the stellar reviews. When I put them all, barely feels like theres any product on them at all. Left them on for the designated 15-20 minutes. Used them every other night. My eyes seem dryer, or no different and no difference in lines or plumpness. They did absolutely nothing.

I was given 2 pairs of these in a goodie bag gift at an event with my company. I first tried them & decided to leave them on all night. They were like dry paper when I woke up in the morning & my eyes looked amazing! The wrinkles were almost completely gone & my skin felt plump & moisturized. So soft & gentle. I'm sold on this product!

I do like these eye patches! I really enjoy using them. It has light and refreshing smell and does calm down my skin in eye area. I always use them after shower at night and next morning I feel my eye area is softer and smoother. It seems kind of expensive but it does have some effects and definitely worth it!
U absolutely LOVE how these feel when applied. Perfect for unwinding and pampering yourself

This actually does what it says it will do! It is pricey but I would pay for it again. I have used in the morning to de-puff and at night before bed. I noticed my eyes looked great when I woke up after using before bed. I have only used 5 times so not sure how it will work on fine lines long term but so far I am happy.

The serum in the product works wonders. I seen a difference within 2 uses, but the gel patches are difficult to keep on in place. Week 1 I've had the container upright, Week 2 I kept the container upside-down in hopes of more moisture & a better stay. I will say that made a difference, but I still find myself holding them in place for a good 3-5 minutes until the product is stuck on. I LOVE the formula, but can't stand that I'm immobile for the suggested 15 mins (lol).

avis.titre: Love, love, love, love!  This product is awesome!
avis.texte: Love this product! Both my husband and I used this on one eye each. We saw an immediate result. I will continue to use these!
Definitely worth the money, I use it every other day and notice a difference. Eyes feel rejuvenated less dark circles and the puffiness is a lot less.
Worth the splurg! I tend to use these a few times a week or if i have a special occasion to attend. Very hydrating and smooths fine lines.

The wrinkles and puffiness under my eyes have always been a source of self consciousness for me. I have tried so many different products and cover ups but these under eye pads have done the job! I was hesitant because of the price but willing to give them a try and I was not dissapointed!

This product was a splurge for me but it is very worth it! I love eye and face masks, and this one leaves a very noticeable difference under my eyes. I can see the effects from where the pads were vs where they were not on my face. My skin is more smoothed out and little plumper (not puffy- but plumped out for smoothing). I will use these before a night out or in the morning if my eyes look like they really need it. I highly recommend.

I would not normally spend this amount on any product. I am going on a cruise and had used products in the spa for under eye circles that worked well. Have been happy so far. Have used 2x pee week. Too expensive to use daily for me. Does what itsays
This works really well for tired puffy eyes. I used it when I had a bad nights sleep and couldn't believe how well it smoothed out the puffiness under my eyes.

I received a single pair from the Peter Thomas Roth "Skin Saver" kit,(which is an amazing deal as well!), and I can honestly say I loved everything about it. However, it was only 1 pair so I'd be super excited to see how a months supply would work!
